RQ1.rationale: Provides a general CubeSat Reference Model technical-measurement pattern, not a complete mission/EPS behavioral model.

RQ2.rationale: Claims traceability, generality, decision support, and conceptual risk/success benefits, but no EPS outcome evidence.

RQ3.rationale: Technical measures and parametric checks are verification-adjacent; formal V&V elements are future work and no EPS verification procedure is integrated.

bibliographic_review_management.lineage_overlap_notes: Part of the INCOSE Space Systems Working Group CubeSat Reference Model lineage; cites Kaslow et al. 2017 interim status #3. study_context_population.mission_platform: CubeSat/nanosatellite-class reference model example; no specific flight mission named.

mbse_objective_scope_artifacts.stated_objective_pain_point: Define how technical measurement should be implemented as part of an MBSE approach, because prior literature tying technical measurement to MBSE is general and lacks detail.
mbse_objective_scope_artifacts.system_boundary_and_abstraction: Mission enterprise level aggregates ground system, launch system, and CubeSat; CubeSat system has MOP value properties; propulsion subsystem has TPMs. The model abstracts technical measures as SysML stereotypes/value properties and parametric relationships rather than detailed physical behavior.
mbse_objective_scope_artifacts.deliberately_minimal_or_excluded: Detailed V&V elements, executable results, specific CubeSat payload, operations, and full EPS architecture are not included; V&V model elements are future work.
mbse_objective_scope_artifacts.required_prior_behavioral_domain_knowled: Limited behavioral knowledge is required initially: qualitative stakeholder concerns and MOE/MOP/TPM specifications can be captured in natural language before quantification. Quantitative relations still require domain functions such as Service Life = f(DeltaV, BatteryCycle, SolarCellLife) and DeltaV = f(propulsion TPMs).
model_artifacts_used: Technical Measures Profile with custom stereotypes/model elements
evidence_quotes: Abstract: "The purpose of this paper is to address that need."
Section 5: "This approach to incorporating technical measures requires the creation of unique model elements that are not part of SysML."
Section 5: "The qualitative descriptions captured in the MOE specifications are now translated into value properties of the mission enterprise."

generality_reuse_mechanism_v1_1_reasonin.rationale: The paper explicitly presents a reusable CubeSat Reference Model, a SysML Technical Measures Profile, and a general method for deriving MOEs, MOPs, and TPMs. The example is mission-level and generic rather than tied to a named mission, supporting high-level abstraction and mission-agnostic architecture. It does not support interface-focused model, low-dynamics / non-detailed-behavior model, or specific-mission model with reusable method only.

evidence.quote: the development of a CubeSat Reference Model that can be used by any CubeSat development team
Figure 1 shows the model elements created as part of the technical measures profile used in this approach.
This approach is not dependent on any specific tool and is general enough to be easily incorporated into many systems engineering methodologies.

reported_steps.name: Create Technical Measures Profile

reported_steps.evidence: Section 5 Technical Measures Profile lists required model elements.

reported_steps.name: Derive mission objectives from stakeholder concerns
inputs: stakeholder concerns from end user and sponsor
reported_steps.completion_criteria: Each critical concern has a corresponding mission objective in the model.
reported_steps.handoffs: Mission objectives are used to derive MOE specifications.
reported_steps.evidence: Section 5: "The approach starts with developing mission objectives derived from the concerns of stakeholders."

reported_steps.name: Capture critical objectives as MOE specifications
inputs: mission objectives deemed critical for mission success
outputs: natural-language MOE specifications, e.g., service life and total cost

reported_steps.handoffs: MOE specifications are translated to quantitative value properties.
reported_steps.evidence: Section 5: unquantified statements are captured as MOE specifications.

reported_steps.name: Translate MOE specifications into mission-enterprise value properties
outputs: MOE value properties such as Service Life and Cost

reported_steps.handoffs: MOE value properties drive MOP derivation and parametric analysis.
reported_steps.evidence: Section 5: "Traceability back to the MOE specifications is accomplished using the trace relationship."

implementation_pathway_tailoring.adoption_guidance_notes: The method sequence is clear, but roles, governance, tool setup, acceptance criteria, and downloadable assets are not provided.

toolchain_interoperability_lifecycle_con.syntax_semantic_continuity_evidence: Within the model, semantic continuity is provided by SysML trace relationships and shared value properties/constraints. Cross-tool syntax/semantic continuity is not reported.
toolchain_interoperability_lifecycle_con.software_hardware_system_integration_rea: Not reported beyond technical measures as a future basis for V&V.
toolchain_interoperability_lifecycle_con.toolchain_limitations: Not reported; paper asserts tool independence.
toolchain_interoperability_lifecycle_con.availability_reproducibility: No model files, open-source assets, reusable packages, exchange formats, scripts, or named tools reported; implementation details are limited to diagrams and textual profile definitions.
evidence_quotes: Section 3: SysML is "well-suited for specifying requirements, structure, behavior, allocations, and constraints on system properties to support engineering analyses."

eps_verification_specific.evidence_integrated_vs_documented_separa: Technical measures and parametric relationships are integrated in the SysML model; formal V&V artifacts are absent and future work.

claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.quote_location: Section 5: "This allows for complete traceability from the quantified value properties of the mission enterprise block back to the originating stakeholder concern. claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.threats_or_alternative_explanations: Traceability is shown in illustrative model diagrams, but ease of impact assessment is not evaluated with user tasks, change scenarios, baseline process data, or project outcomes.

claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.baseline_comparator: No manual-analysis or alternative-toolchain comparator reported.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.observed_effect_size_or_qualitative_effe: Qualitative capability claim; no executed trade study results or numerical outputs are reported in this paper.

claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.claim_text_or_paraphrase: The approach is general, tool-independent, and reusable across systems engineering methodologies and CubeSat teams via the CubeSat Reference Model and Technical Measures Profile.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.linked_artifact_process: CubeSat Reference Model, SysML Technical Measures Profile, and method guidance for deriving technical measures.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.baseline_comparator: No reuse across projects or independent replication is reported.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.observed_effect_size_or_qualitative_effe: Asserted generality; no measured reuse or adoption evidence.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.quote_location: Introduction: "CubeSat Reference Model that can be used by any CubeSat development team." Conclusion: "This approach is not dependent on any specific tool and is general enough to be easily incorporated into many systems engineering methodologies."
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.threats_or_alternative_explanations: Tool independence is asserted from use of SysML/profile concepts but no implementation in multiple tools, exchange format, package, or replicated adoption is shown.

claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.claim_text_or_paraphrase: Applying technical measurement in a CubeSat MBSE model could improve mission success by addressing high failure rates and providing insight into development progress and risks.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.linked_artifact_process: Technical measures (MOEs, MOPs, TPMs) represented and traced within the CubeSat system model.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.baseline_comparator: No prior mission, failure-rate, reliability, or risk baseline comparison reported.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.observed_effect_size_or_qualitative_effe: Potential success/risk benefit is asserted conceptually; no reliability proxy results or mission outcome evidence.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.quote_location: Abstract: "Using a CubeSat example is appropriate given the historically high failure rate and rapid growth of these missions and the role technical measurement could play in increasing their success." Technical measurement definition: measures "provide insight into the progress... and the associated risks and issues".
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.threats_or_alternative_explanations: High CubeSat failure rates may be driven by factors outside technical measurement; the paper provides no causal evidence that this MBSE approach improves reliability or mission assurance.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.reliability_subtype_rationale: This claim links CubeSat high failure rate, mission success, risk insight, and technical measurement. It should not be coded as EPS reliability because the paper does not provide an EPS-specific reliability claim.

key_findings_by_rq.RQ1: Useful supporting evidence for a generic CubeSat system-level MBSE technical-measurement pattern using a SysML profile/reference model and minimal initial qualitative stakeholder knowledge; not a full mission/EPS behavioral model.
key_findings_by_rq.RQ2: Claims traceability, trade/decision support, qualitative measure completeness, generality/reuse, and conceptual risk/mission-success benefits, but outcome evidence is illustrative and lacks metrics/baseline/validation.
key_findings_by_rq.RQ3: Verification integration is not implemented. Technical measures and parametric checks are verification-adjacent, and V&V model elements are explicitly future work.

author_stated_limitations_gaps: Future work needed to incorporate V&V model elements and relate them to technical measures.
